label: reciprocity_from_literature
summary: Extracts existence of local reciprocity from the supplied literature record.

label: covolume_bound
summary: Derives the required covolume bound from arithmetic geometry inputs including Hilbert–Samuel, positivity, toroidal compactifications and deformation theory.

label: theta_to_Galois
summary: Converts the theta lift and the geometric input into the local–global reciprocity row.

label: theta_lift
summary: Supplies the theta lift fed into the Galois representation construction.

label: Galois_row
summary: The local–global Galois row for the reciprocity parameter comes from the theta-lift construction.

label: local_Langlands
summary: Constructs the local reciprocity datum and proves its required compatibility properties.

label: automorphic_window
summary: Turns the local–global row and base-change input into the automorphic window.

label: third_place_inputs
summary: Assembles the unitary-group third-place hypotheses from the literature package.

label: theta_local_inputs
summary: Builds the local theta input record used in the matching argument.

label: theta_matching
summary: Produces both agreement of theta integrals and local matching.

label: definite_side
summary: Uses the theta, covolume and reciprocity data to construct the definite-side hypotheses.

label: family_zero_free
summary: Derives primitive-character zero-freeness from connected families and a host for each character.

label: primitive_zero_free
summary: Supplies the family and host inputs using the Green condition, the window and the definite-side hypotheses.

label: change_of_level
summary: Extends primitive-character nonvanishing to arbitrary level by the change-of-level formula and nonzero Euler factors.

label: all_levels
summary: Combines primitive nonvanishing with change of level to cover every Dirichlet character.

label: theta_to_nonvanishing
summary: Uses regular characters for the Green condition and theta matching for the definite-side hypotheses, then applies the all-level theorem.

label: literature_to_nonvanishing
summary: Feeds the assembled third-place and theta inputs, both matching facts, a covolume bound, local reciprocity and the window into the theta argument.

label: row_to_nonvanishing
summary: Supplies the row twice in the literature record, supplies local reciprocity, and builds the required window from that row.

label: every_character
summary: Applies the row-to-nonvanishing implication to the constructed Galois row.

label: Euler_factor
summary: A removed prime Euler factor cannot vanish when the real part is positive.

label: primitive_zero
summary: A zero in the open strip descends to the primitive character after removing the nonvanishing Euler factors.

label: strip_gamma
summary: The character gamma factor is nonzero in the open right half-plane.

label: reflect_zero
summary: Reflects a primitive zero to the inverse character at one minus the original point by the completed functional equation.

label: Dirichlet_strip
summary: For a zero left of the critical line, descend to the primitive character and reflect it into the zero-free half-plane. Right-side zeros are excluded directly.

label: zeta_claim
summary: Uses the level-one instance of the strip result and the zeta functional equation outside the strip. This is a component of the conjunction used by an export.

label: primitive_gamma
summary: Proves gamma-factor nonvanishing in the separate primitive-character reduction.

label: primitive_line
summary: Reflects a primitive Dirichlet zero and applies the half-plane hypothesis. This is the reduction used by the original primitive export.

label: zeta_reflection
summary: Reflects a nontrivial zeta zero to show that right-half-plane nonvanishing forces real part one half.

label: level_one_zeta
summary: Specializes all-character nonvanishing to the trivial character at level one, identifies its L-function with zeta, and applies reflection.

label: half_plane_input
summary: Binds the all-character theorem used by the public-facing wrappers.

label: RH_wrapper
summary: Supplies the half-plane input to the level-one zeta reduction.

label: strip_bundle
summary: Stores half-plane nonvanishing, the strip result, and the zeta result in one conjunction. The all-character strip export selects its middle field.

label: primitive_wrapper
summary: Supplies the half-plane input to the primitive critical-line reduction.

label: Riemann_hypothesis
summary: The public Riemann hypothesis theorem in Mathlib’s formulation.

label: zeta_zeros
summary: The explicitly quantified claim about the real parts of nontrivial zeta zeros uses the same proof as RH.

label: Dirichlet_nonvanishing
summary: The public nonvanishing theorem for Dirichlet L-functions to the right of the critical line, with the stated exception at one.

label: Dirichlet_zeros
summary: The public strip result for all characters projects the middle field of the conjunction.

label: primitive_zeros
summary: The public strip result for primitive characters uses the dedicated primitive wrapper.
